newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.1 pct in w/e July 7.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.1 pct in w/e July 7.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have slowed in the week ended July 7 to 0.1 percent from 0.2 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
It said that if current price trends continued, monthly inflation for the whole of July would be 0.4 percent and half-year inflation would be nine percent.
The monthly inflation rate for June was 1.1 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended July 7 June 30
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of prices for 37 basic goods and services.

Russian agencies said on Thursday the committee would stop publishing weekly inflation reports from July. Interfax news agency quoted a committee official as saying publication was not necessary due to what it said were low inflation rates.
